dashboard.welcome_desc: Modern and interactive restaurant booking system.

chatbot.greeting: Hello! Welcome to RestoBook. I am RestoBot, ready to help you find menu information, how to reserve, opening hours, and everything on our website. How can I help you?
chatbot.greeting_customer: Hello, {name}! Welcome back to RestoBook. I can help you check reservations, orders, reward points, or other things. How can I help you?
chatbot.greeting_cashier: Have a good shift, {name}! I am RestoBot, ready to assist your cashier operations. I can help check table status, transactions, or revenue recap for this shift.
chatbot.greeting_admin: Welcome, {name}! The RestoBook dashboard is ready. I can help you with reports, menu management, staff, inventory, or customer complaints.
chatbot.error: Sorry, I am currently unable to connect. Please try again in a moment.
chatbot.jailbreak: Sorry, I am RestoBot and can only assist with RestoBook information. Please ask questions about our menu, reservations, or services.
